newsitem.title: CANADA: Anvil Range gains on strong buy rating.
newsitem.headline: Anvil Range gains on strong buy rating.

text.p: Anvil Range Mining Corp shares rose on Thursday after brokerage Nesbitt Burns initiated coverage with a strong buy recommendation.
Shares in the base metals miner were up 0.80 to 6.45 on more than 437,000 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Nesbitt Burns said it set a 12-month price target of C$10 for the stock.
Anvil Range has attracted attention since analysts visited its Yukon property a week ago, Anvil Range president Kurt Forgaard said in an phone interview.
On Wednesday, the company said earnings from its Faro mine in the Yukon were strong enough to prepay a US$15 million bridge loan to its major shareholder, Hyundai Canada Inc.
